About LC Consults

LC Consults Nigeria Limited is a registered Nigerian construction and civil engineering company (RC 9810425), providing building construction, road construction, drainage works and general civil engineering services.

Our objects, as registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission, cover building construction, civil engineering services, general construction and real estate. In practice, that means we take projects from planning through to delivery, with project management handled in-house.

Work built to standard, not shortcuts.
